body:
Tested locally, it works as expected.

**Testing project:** [test_pr_121022.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30104863/test_pr_121022.zip)

However, I'm not sure this is a good idea, as PathFollow3D follows the baked curve closely. This is what it looks like in `master`:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1a81fdd8-0aa3-4065-a353-6d20e2630a3f

With this PR, it looks like this:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6fad8b62-db2f-474a-8038-cebe7208d1d6

I think a [preview resolution editor setting](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/90357#issuecomment-2357790955) and having a way to disable fish bones on a per-Path3D basis is preferable, but that PR needs work before it's in a mergeable state.
